title: The Word Threshold
short_teaser: Threshold originally referred to the piece of wood or stone at the bottom of a doorway.
story: Threshold originally referred to the piece of wood or stone at the bottom of a doorway. It became a word for the point where one state, place, or stage begins. A physical boundary became language for transition. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
